deviations_from_card: (1) Commit order: feat, then the test commit, then package.json. All 8 non-guard cases are red until the feature lands, so the suite rides in a test commit after the fix, as the brief allows. Red-before was measured in the working tree before any source change: 8 red (cases 1-6, the critic's parseDetail case and the extra import check), GUARD green. The 9 counted cases are cases 1-6, the GUARD, case 8 (the Playwright journey) and the critic's parseDetail case. (2) The operator's binding taste overrides the card body's 'Recap screen (On Air) draws the tiles with thin channel tags'. The shell stays On Air: the title 'Tonight, done', the caption chip, the desk button and a band-rule, so one band. The rail is dropped. Each tile wears its own app's classes and tokens: maths-tv + MATHS_FONTS (Lamplight folder, paper, pen ticks and rings), a cream card with the plum arch and the Linga mark (Open Door), essay-tv + ESSAY_FONTS (Specimen black card, E-caret brand, citron reversed arrows). There are no channel tags; the app marks name the tiles. (3) The card offers 'sized by its replies' for Linga. Each conversation is a plum disc 48+8*min(turns,14) px with its reply count inside, in Georgia. Essay: the history line gives counts, not positions, so the reversed arrows are drawn after the others. (4) The caption chip is the learner's name, because the rail that named them is gone. The recap's .cap is raised to 28 px (On Air's .cap is 26 px), which the browser gate's 'nothing under 28 px' check caught. (5) Maths tile: 'empty' is null when any practice or homework line is dated tonight, or s.log.hints > 0. An unparsable line keeps the tile drawn with no set invented (critic revise). log.hints and log.hard are session-wide, as the card specifies; they are not dated. (6) ownReading(s) sits in recapRows.ts. It repeats the landing's 'this learner's paragraph' test, because landingRows.ts is outside the write set. (7) Case 3 counts JSX text in the '// ---- T12 Recap' to '// ---- T13' section of screens.tsx, plus the learner's name, the longest caption the rows give and the 'Not tonight' empty. The count is 24 of 25 (the regex over-counts one stray token). In the live DOM, brand marks and lens labels aside, it is 19 words. (8) No session event or state was added, and store.ts is untouched. session.end already existed and already sets screen 'recap', focus 0. nav landing without a focus already rests the lamp (LANDING_REST).
